text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co, a unit of Unicom Corp, said the Nuclear Regulatory Commission notified it of a $650,000 proposed fine as a result of operations at the company's LaSalle County Generations Station.
Thomas Maiman, Commonwealth Edison's executive vice of nuclear operations, acknowledged that performance during the incident was not acceptable.

The fine relates to a June 1996 incident involving the service water tunnel at the LaSalle plant. The unit, in Seneca, Ill., was shut to correct a valve problem in the reactor. It was triggered by the failure of the unit's main steam isolation valves to close during a test, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said at the time.
In August, Commonwealth Edison replaced the site vice president and several senior and middle managers.
